meta.title: Ondra memory dream
meta.description: Three mutually exclusive nightly consolidations. The gated branch adds only facts with a verbatim source quote, behind four gates: quote must be verbatim, persona rewrites refused, duplicates refused, impersonal engineering notes refused. The lightweight branch mines five card types from tool signals with pure rules after two minutes of idleness and deeper at five, with no model calls, and unused cards decay on a 168-hour half-life without ever being deleted. The surreal branch links distant memories with surreal edges that never enter retrieval and leaves one dream utterance to be injected, labelled as such, at the next first turn.
